name: Harvest Miracle Capital Berhad
overview: Harvest Miracle Capital Berhad 今年出售了全资子公司 Teras Gemumi Sdn. Bhd. 的全部股权（RM51.6 million），并认购了 Kaw Kaw Malaya Sdn. Bhd. 40% 的股权（总投入 RM4.4 million）。公司还提议将业务多元化至建筑材料的采购、供应、履约和贸易。
overview_en: Harvest Miracle Capital Berhad disposed of its entire equity interest in wholly-owned subsidiary Teras Gemumi Sdn. Bhd. for RM51.6 million this year, and subscribed for 40% of Kaw Kaw Malaya Sdn. Bhd. for a total investment of RM4.4 million. The company also proposed to diversify its businesses to include the sourcing, procurement, fulfillment and trading of construction materials.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面进行了子公司股权出售、新业务股权投资以及业务多元化提议。
segments.note_en: At the group level this year, there were a subsidiary disposal, an equity investment in a new business, and a proposed business diversification.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 提议将现有业务多元化至建筑材料的采购、供应、履约和贸易。
actions.text_en: Proposed to diversify the existing businesses to include the sourcing, procurement, fulfillment and trading of construction materials.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以 RM40,000 现金认购 Kaw Kaw Malaya Sdn. Bhd. 40% 股权，并提供 RM4,360,000 股东垫款，总投入 RM4,400,000。
actions.text_en: Subscribed for 40% of Kaw Kaw Malaya Sdn. Bhd. for a cash consideration of RM40,000, together with a shareholder's advance of RM4,360,000, amounting to a total investment of RM4,400,000.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以 RM51.6 million 现金代价出售全资子公司 Teras Gemumi Sdn. Bhd. 的全部股权。
actions.text_en: Disposed of the entire equity interest in wholly-owned subsidiary Teras Gemumi Sdn. Bhd. for a total cash consideration of RM51.6 million.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 出售 Teras Gemumi Sdn. Bhd. 全部股权，该公司及其子公司将不再为公司的子公司。
model_changes.text_en: Disposal of the entire equity interest in Teras Gemumi Sdn. Bhd., which together with its subsidiary will cease to be a subsidiary of the company.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 提议将业务多元化至建筑材料的采购、供应、履约和贸易，属于新增业务线。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed diversification into the sourcing, procurement, fulfillment and trading of construction materials, representing a new business line.
